verdict.rationale: Snowflake's first-party Time Travel docs explicitly cover both halves of the story. You can access historical data at any point within a defined period, including querying data that has since been updated or deleted. You can also restore accidentally or intentionally deleted objects, either individual tables or whole containers. missing for 10: explicit evidence of restoring a corrupted (not dropped) table to a prior state (e.g., clone/AT-point recovery), retention-period details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
